overal.goal: audit.ts records the socket peer, which behind nginx is always 127.0.0.1, so a leaked key cannot be traced. When the peer is loopback and X-Forwarded-For/Forwarded is present, record the first forwarded address in a clearly labelled `forwardedFor` field (untrusted).
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

audit lines carry forwardedFor (the last X-Forwarded-For entry or the last Forwarded for=) when the peer is loopback or a trusted proxy; ip stays the socket peer; the value is documented as trustworthy only with security.trustedProxies. Deviation from the goal text: the last entry, not the first, because the first is client-controlled.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
